# Version 4.152.4 (Unreleased)
> **Failed flush cache cleanup**

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.204/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.4 clears uniquely held Ganesh cache entries after failed flushes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Failed flushes no longer leave reusable uninitialized cache textures** — Drops uniquely held thread-safe-cache entries after unsuccessful GPU work so later draws cannot reuse those entries. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed. ([#5287](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5287))
